source.name: Food Composition Table for Bangladesh
source.publisher: Institute of Nutrition and Food Science, University of Dhaka
source.support: NFPCSP, Ministry of Food (GoB), FAO, USAID, EU

notes.values_basis: All per_100g values are copied from the FCT, edible portion, fresh weight.
notes.portion_basis: portion_grams is OUR assumption for a typical household serving. It is NOT from the FCT.
notes.cooked_values: The FCT derives cooked-food values using yield and retention factors rather than analysing each cooked dish. Noted as a limitation.
notes.preparation: Boiled entries are without salt or oil. Real home cooking adds both.
notes.glycemic_class: Assigned by us from carbohydrate content and common dietary guidance; NOT measured GI values from the FCT.
notes.coverage: Groups 01-05 (cereals, pulses, vegetables, leafy vegetables, starchy roots) transcribed. Groups 06-15 (nuts, spices, fruits, fish, meat, eggs, milk, oils, beverages) NOT yet transcribed - queries about them are correctly refused.
notes.pipeline: bd_foods_master.csv is the source of truth; this file is generated by csv_to_json.py.
